messages.author: 90844fba118f5166
messages.subject: 502 errors
parts:
I'm getting 502 errors trying to access my running applications. 


When I go back, I am notified that:

An error has occurred

The application failed to start.

The application took too long to respond.


The first thing my app does is load a rather large dataset into memory, which takes some time. Perhaps this is the issue? Is so, any way that timeout could be extended?
Any help woulds be appreciated.

Tim

messages.author: 90844fba118f5166
messages.subject: Re: 502 errors
parts:
Just a quick followup -- I had been loading the data prior to the shinyServer call. Loading that data within the shinyServer call fixed the problem.

Tim

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: 502 errors
parts:
Thanks for the update.

The right person to answer the question about whether the timeout can be extended is Andy, but I wanted to ask, would it be possible to make the data load more quickly? Possibly by doing some preprocessing/summarizing locally and saving the result to an .rds file, which is then what is uploaded and loaded into the Shiny app? When possible, loading prior to the shinyServer call is preferred since you only have to pay the loading cost once (and also save memory).

messages.author: 90844fba118f5166
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: 502 errors
parts:
I got the initial load time and subsequent computation time down by preprocessing and indexing the data ahead of time. Now I can generally load the data before the server starts before getting a 502 error. However, I do still get them occasionally, and when I do, it seems to send the app into an error state that required me to manually restart the App.

The load time is only a second or two on my laptop. Is there any way to increase the tolerance for preload times on the server?

Tim

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: 502 errors
parts:
Tim,

It sounds like your application may be running out of memory, causing the application instance to crash. By default, application instances are limited to 256MB of memory. I would read the section of the guide on Application Instances and possibly try increasing size of the instances you are using.

Regards,
-Andy

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: 502 errors
parts:
Thanks Andy.

I had already increased the application to be "medium" to be conservative. However, the data in my app takes up 100Mb of data, and total workspace memory is well south of 256Mb. I can try larger instances, but I don't see that as the issue here. Also, it usually works and only occasionally fails on loading, whereas I would expect running out of memory would always fail.

Tim
